media_catalog.chapter_title: Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic, and Neutral

hotspots.label: Acidic vs Basic Litmus Reaction
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Acids turn blue litmus paper red, whereas bases turn red litmus paper blue; neutral solutions show no color change.

hotspots.label: Natural Turmeric Indicator Shift
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Turmeric remains yellow in acidic and neutral media but turns deep reddish-brown in basic solutions like soap.

video_overview.title: The Ant Bite Mystery
video_overview.topics_covered: Acids and Bases, Litmus & Turmeric Indicators, Neutralization Reaction, Treating Ant Bites with Baking Soda

hotspots.label: Electric Cell & Battery Polarity
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: An electric cell has a positive metal cap and negative disc; connecting cell positive to negative forms a battery in series.

hotspots.label: LED Forward Bias Requirement
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: LEDs permit current flow in only one direction; the longer lead (anode) must connect to the positive terminal.

video_overview.title: Electricity: Circuits
video_overview.topics_covered: Circuit Symbols, Series Batteries, LED Semiconductor Properties, Conductors and Insulators, Human Electrical Safety

media_catalog.chapter_title: The World of Metals and Non-metals

image_asset.title: Metals vs Non-Metals Physical & Chemical Profile

hotspots.label: Malleability & Ductility
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Metals can be hammered into thin sheets (malleable) and drawn into fine wires (ductile), unlike brittle non-metals.

hotspots.label: Basic vs Acidic Oxides
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Metal oxides (e.g. MgO) dissolve in water to form basic solutions, while non-metal oxides (e.g. SO2) form acidic solutions.

video_overview.title: Metals & Non-metals
video_overview.topics_covered: Physical Properties of Elements, Malleability & Ductility, Metal & Non-metal Oxides, Physical Exceptions

media_catalog.chapter_title: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical

hotspots.label: Reversible Physical State Change
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Physical changes alter state, shape, or size without forming new chemical substances (e.g. ice melting).

hotspots.label: Irreversible Chemical Reaction
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Chemical changes produce new substances with distinct chemical compositions (e.g. lime water precipitation, rusting).

video_overview.title: Changes Around Us
video_overview.topics_covered: Physical vs Chemical Changes, Combustion Mechanics, Lime Water CO2 Test, Rusting and Galvanization

media_catalog.chapter_title: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change

hotspots.label: Growth Spurt & Secondary Sexual Traits
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Rapid height velocity, larynx enlargement forming Adams apple in boys, and pelvic widening in girls.

hotspots.label: Pituitary Endocrine Control Axis
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Master pituitary gland secretes hormones driving testosterone and estrogen synthesis, regulating puberty and menarche.

video_overview.title: Journey of Growing Up
video_overview.topics_covered: Adolescence and Puberty, Secondary Sexual Characteristics, Endocrine System, Menstrual Hygiene & Iron Nutrition

hotspots.label: Conduction in Solids
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Heat moves through solids via adjacent particle vibrations without net displacement of the material.

hotspots.label: Fluid Convection & Coastal Breezes
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Density changes in heated fluids drive bulk particle movement, generating sea breezes by day and land breezes by night.

video_overview.title: Heat Transfer in Nature
video_overview.topics_covered: Thermal Conduction, Fluid Convection Currents, Radiation Waves, Sea and Land Breeze Mechanics

hotspots.label: Isochronous Simple Pendulum
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: A simple pendulum completes back-and-forth swings in a constant time period determined strictly by string length.

hotspots.label: Distance-Time Graph Slope = Speed
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: A straight sloped line indicates uniform motion at constant speed; a horizontal line indicates zero speed at rest.

video_overview.title: Measurement of Time & Motion
video_overview.topics_covered: Simple Pendulum Mechanics, Speed Calculations, SI Units, Uniform vs Non-Uniform Motion, Distance-Time Analysis

image_asset.title: Human Alimentary Canal, Villi & Cellular Respiration

hotspots.label: Small Intestine Villi Absorption
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Microscopic vascular villi massively increase surface area for absorbing digested nutrients directly into blood.

hotspots.label: Cellular Respiration ATP Yield
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Biochemical oxidation of absorbed glucose in cells combines with oxygen to produce carbon dioxide, water, and ATP energy.

video_overview.title: The Journey of Energy
video_overview.topics_covered: Alimentary Canal Digestion, Enzymatic Breakdown, Intestinal Villi Absorption, Cellular Respiration, Cattle Rumination

hotspots.label: Stomatal Guard Cell Exchange
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Microscopic stomata flanked by guard cells regulate carbon dioxide intake, oxygen release, and transpiration water loss.

hotspots.label: Dual Vascular Transport (Xylem & Phloem)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Xylem carries water/minerals unidirectionally upward; phloem translocates synthesized sugars multidirectionally.

video_overview.title: Life Processes of Plants
video_overview.topics_covered: Photosynthesis Equation, Chlorophyll Starch Synthesis, Stomatal Mechanics, Xylem vs Phloem Transport

image_asset.title: Rectilinear Light Propagation & Laws of Reflection

hotspots.label: Rectilinear Propagation & Pinhole Camera
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Light travels in straight lines; pinhole cameras project real, inverted, colored images through tiny apertures.

hotspots.label: Law of Reflection (Angle i = Angle r)
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection relative to the normal line, producing laterally inverted images.

video_overview.title: The Journey of Light
video_overview.topics_covered: Rectilinear Propagation of Light, Shadows and Pinhole Camera, Laws of Reflection, Plane Mirrors & Periscopes

image_asset.title: Earth Axial Tilt, Lunar Phases & Eclipse Alignment

hotspots.label: 23.5 Degree Axial Tilt & Seasons
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Earth rotation on its tilted axis causes day/night, while annual orbital revolution combined with axial tilt produces seasons.

hotspots.label: Solar & Lunar Eclipse Shadow Alignments
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Exact linear alignment of Sun-Moon-Earth causes Solar Eclipses on New Moon; Sun-Earth-Moon causes Lunar Eclipses on Full Moon.

video_overview.topics_covered: Earth Rotation & Axial Tilt, Lunar Synchronous Rotation, Phases of the Moon, Solar and Lunar Eclipse Alignment
